claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
8:07 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026 corresponds to 00:07 UTC on April 11.
The crew consisted of four astronauts.
The crew completed their 10-day mission around the moon.
The crew were recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
Artemis II launch date was April 1, 2026.
Artemis II mission duration was ~10 days.
Artemis II splashdown time was 8:07 p.m. EDT, April 10, 2026.
Artemis II splashdown location was Pacific Ocean near San Diego, California.
Artemis II crew was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The capsule and crew were retrieved shortly after landing.
Artemis II was the first human trip to the moon in over 50 years.
